title: Object Storage: outage authorize — recorded outcome
content:
For Object Storage outage authorize,  The customer authorizes the maximum available refund, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision, after being shown its original-payment destination; the authorization is exact and not a blank mandate.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage authorize in this situation?  The customer authorizes the maximum available refund, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision, after being shown its original-payment destination; the authorization is exact and not a blank mandate.

## Hypothetical outage authorize amount

Assume a hypothetical maximum permitted cash return of USD 52.75. After the original-payment destination is shown, the customer authorizes exactly USD 52.75. This amount is a specific authorization.
